build_blender_model: build and download a Blender model to a specified datapath using the build function
print_blender_ascii: print the Blender ASCII art text file to the console using print_blender
check_blender_built: check if a Blender model has already been built at a given path and version
download_blender_models: download Blender model files from ParlAI using the download_models utility
review_build_function: review the build function to understand how Blender models are downloaded and versioned
